∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (τ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (a b : ℝ),
0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → KdVPlan.Traj gamma M τ L f v → KdVPlan.GridInterval τ L a b → KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v ≤ 1 →
KdVPlan.UB 0 a b (fun t => KdVPlan.residual τ f t-KdVPlan.residual τ f a)
(C*(b-a+τ)*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v))
proof:
intro M hM
rcases @yui_aux_0104 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M hM with ⟨C,hC,hCl⟩
refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
intro τ L f v a b hτ hτ1 htr hg hE t ht
have hq0 : 0 ≤ τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v :=
  add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ.le _) (@yui_aux_0120 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hτ htr hg).2.2.2.2.1
have hgrid := @yui_aux_0122 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 M τ L f v a b hM hτ hτ1 htr hg hE
have hidx := @yui_aux_0123 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ L a b t hτ hg ht
rcases hg.2.2.2 with ⟨n0,hn0,ha⟩
have hge : n0 ≤ KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t := by
  have hh := Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (show (n0 : ℝ)*τ ≤ t by rwa [← ha]) hτ.le)
  simpa [KdVPlan.gridIndex,hτ.ne'] using hh
have hbidx := (@yui_aux_0110 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ hτ).1 t (hg.1.trans ht.1)
have hρ : ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ L → (j : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b →
∀ r ∈ Set.Icc ((j : ℝ)*τ) ((j : ℝ)*τ+τ), KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.rho ((j : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f j) r) (C*τ*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) := by
  intro j hj hjt r hr
  have hs := hgrid j hj hjt
  have hb := (hCl _ _ _ _ hs.1).2.1 r hr
  exact ⟨hb.1,hb.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 (mul_nonneg hC.le hτ.le))⟩
have hsum := @yui_aux_0125 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 0 (C*τ*(τ^gamma+KdVPlan.enorm a b τ f v)) (Finset.Ico n0 (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t))
 (fun j => KdVPlan.rho ((j : ℝ)*τ) τ (KdVPlan.twistedNum τ f j) (((j : ℝ)+1)*τ)) (by
  intro j hj
  have hj' := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj
  have hjL : j ≤ L := (Nat.le_of_lt hj'.2).trans hidx.1
  have hcastlo : (n0 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj'.1
  have hcasthi : (j : ℝ) ≤ (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt hj'.2)
  have hjt : (j : ℝ)*τ ∈ Set.Icc a b := ⟨by rw [ha]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcastlo hτ.le,
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcasthi hτ.le).trans hidx.2.2⟩
  apply hρ j hjL hjt (((j : ℝ)+1)*τ)
  constructor <;> nlinarith only [hτ])
have hlast := hρ _ hidx.1 hidx.2 t ⟨hbidx.1,by nlinarith only [hbidx.2]⟩
have hb := ((@yui_aux_0068 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013).1 0 _ _ _ _ hsum hlast).1
rw [show (fun t => KdVPlan.residual τ f t-KdVPlan.residual τ f a) t =
  KdVPlan.residual τ f t-KdVPlan.residual τ f ((n0 : ℝ)*τ) by rw [← ha],
 @yui_aux_0126 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 τ f n0 t hτ (by rwa [← ha])]
refine ⟨hb.1,hb.2.trans ?_⟩
have hcount : (((Finset.Ico n0 (KdVPlan.gridIndex τ t)).card : ℝ)+1)*τ ≤ b-a+τ := by
  rw [Nat.card_Ico,Nat.cast_sub hge]
  rw [ha]
  nlinarith only [hidx.2.2]
have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount (mul_nonneg hC.le hq0)
nlinarith only [hh]
